{{Quote|Here on Shramar, all of the ground defenses are pulling back closer to the ''Heart of Artorias'', the ship at the center of this evacuation effort.|[[Cianba]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]|<ref name="Invasion: Revelations 5">[[Invasion: Revelations 5|''Invasion: Revelations'' 5]]</ref>}}
The '''Battle of Shramar''' was an engagement fought between a joint [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] force and the [[Praetorite Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].

During the battle, the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Cianba]] reported live on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] the progress of the fight before being forced to shoot the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to defend her life.

The New Republic and Imperial forces resisted long enough to evacuate in the ''[[Heart of Artorias]]'' all the refugees present on the planet.
